
# Additional Visualisation

## Box Plot of Fatty Acid Measurements

The box plot compares the distributions of different fatty acids in Italian olive oil samples.

It helps us understand:

- The median measurement of each fatty acid.
- The spread and variation in the measurements.
- Potential outliers.
- Differences between fatty acid distributions.

![Box plot comparing fatty acid measurements](../../artefacts/olive_oil_fatty_acids_boxplot.png)

The box plot complements the pairwise scatterplot matrix. While the scatterplot matrix helps identify relationships between variables, the box plot focuses on the distribution and variation of individual fatty acids.

# Conclusion

This exploratory analysis provides an overview of the chemical composition of Italian olive oils.

The summary statistics describe the typical values and variation of fatty acid measurements. The pairwise scatterplot matrix helps identify relationships, clusters and potential outliers. The additional box plot provides another way to compare the distributions of fatty acids.

Combining summary statistics and visualisations provides a clearer understanding of the dataset and helps communicate findings effectively.
